{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check unique values in customer_segment
unique_segments = sales_df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check unique values in status
unique_status = sales_df['status'].unique()

# Check the distribution of revenue
revenue_stats = sales_df['revenue'].describe()

missing_values, duplicates, unique_segments, unique_status, revenue_stats"}
